title: Analysis pipeline for 183 infectious bronchitis virus genomes from the Republic of Korea
description: Read checking, de novo assembly and contig finishing, annotation with the replicase ribosomal frameshift located on each genome, quality control, S1 lineage assignment, and the derivation of the figure source data for the 183 infectious bronchitis virus genomes deposited under NCBI BioProject PRJNA1537317.
